curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can Gail and Tom hold together as their rafting holiday becomes a nightmare?
curatedMovie.description: A strained couple takes their son on a Montana rafting trip, then encounters two mysterious men whose desperation turns it into a nightmare.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful, and emotionally tense. An adrenaline-charged river survival adventure with high dramatic stakes.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Curtis Hanson steers a high-stakes outdoor thriller, fusing intense river rapids with simmering family drama for a gripping, pulse-pounding ride.
